p: that the judges may judge them: Whether there is a plaintiff or not, the magistrates should try our faults, and punish according to the crime.
and to be beaten before his: When the crime does not deserve death.
Forty stripes he may give him: The superstition Jews later removed one, 2Co 11:24.

husband's brother shall go in unto: Because the Hebrew word does not signify the natural brother, and the word that signifies a brother, is taken also for a kinsman: it seems that it does not mean that the natural brother should marry his brothers wife, but some other kindred that was in the degree that might marry.
When men strive together one with: This law imputes that godly shamefacedness is preferred: for it is a horrible thing to see a woman past shame.
remembrance of Amalek from under heaven: This was partly accomplished by Saul, about 450 years later.
